ترعرعت (form IIq)
# تَرَعْرَعْتُ (taraʕraʕtu) /ta.raʕ.raʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَرَعْرَعَ (taraʕraʕa)
# تَرَعْرَعْتَ (taraʕraʕta) /ta.raʕ.raʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَرَعْرَعَ (taraʕraʕa)
# تَرَعْرَعْتِ (taraʕraʕti) /ta.raʕ.raʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَرَعْرَعَ (taraʕraʕa)
# تَرَعْرَعَتْ (taraʕraʕat) /ta.raʕ.ra.ʕat/: t
